activation_condition: Stage C demo_adoption.decision == pass on the frozen twelve-seed held-out evaluation
path_frame: robot body frame; no rotation of the bank toward a goal
predictor_target: two-second body-frame XY displacement per Path
selection_goal: global goal in current robot body frame
selection_score_unit: metres of predicted global-goal distance reduction
legacy_fallback: explicit old MI-B Full seed-456 checkpoint with its existing seven-forward-arc demo mode
mode_compatibility: never feed fourteen Paths to the six-slot legacy model or silently load a checkpoint with a different candidate count/order
runtime_verification: all fourteen candidate Paths and RViz visualization
forward and reverse Path publication to the follower core
Goal, Cancel, Timeout and fall-reset behavior
GUI startup through Isaac motion and explicit legacy fallback
interpretation: GUI integration is conditional on Stage C adoption; a successful load or unit test alone does not establish driving performance
